items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: In the saxophone section, as I say, we had Darnell Howard, Omer Simeon on lead sax, James Mundy on tenor sax, Cecil Irwin on tenor sax

ctx.x: That's right, he was there. He was there with his wife. That's right. Him and Hilliard sat together.
You have George Dixon -- in the brass section we had George Dixon, Charlie Allen, Walter Fuller, and we had so many other trumpet players, man, I can't think of all of them.
